description:
Run a comparative aerodynamic analysis using Blade Element Momentum (BEM) and Lifting Line Theory (LLT) in QBlade.

1. Open the 'Turbine Simulation.wpa' sample project from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/.
2. In the Rotor BEM Simulation module, run a Single Point simulation at TSR = 7. Note the Power Coefficient (Cp).
3. In the Rotor LLT Simulation module, set up a simulation with: TSR = 7, Number of Revolutions = 15, and Rigid Wake = Off. Run the simulation and note the converged Cp.
4. Take a screenshot of the 3D wake visualization showing the helical vortices.
5. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/bem_vs_llt.txt' and write the two Cp values inside (e.g., 'BEM: 0.48, LLT: 0.46').
6. Save the project including the simulation results to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/comparison_study.wpa'.
